description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for a stream stage within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for retrieving parallelism and back-off configurations, as well as an enumeration of known config values.

classes.name: StreamStageConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for stream stages, including parallelism and back-off configuration.

classes.name: StreamStageConfig.StreamStageConfigValue
classes.description: An enum listing known configuration path expressions with default values for stream stage configurations.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of parallel operations allowed.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the back-off configuration used in case of failure.
